text:
olivia: FYI Veridian wants to upgrade to 50 seats but procurement wants a staged acceptance: 6mo pilot then auto-convert to annual. Need decision by EOD to keep SE enablement slot next week.
james: PM ok with 6mo pilot if price clear. what discount are they asking?
olivia: they asked for ~20% off for the 6mo, full price on conversion. finance worried about churn.
anya: legal: primary signer OOO until Mon. can delegated signer sign?
legal-bot: Delegated signing allowed if Delegation of Authority or PO shows delegated signer. Recommend one-pager addendum.
miguel: propose Docusign + witness. if bank insists on wet-sign we need timeline buffer.
procurement-bot: Drafting PO template with vendor code + delegated signer field. ETA 2h.
james: also need SE week Apr10-14 held; missing EOD risks losing slot.
olivia: customer prefers invoice split: 50% upfront for pilot, remainder on convert. finance prefers full upfront.
anya: recommend 50% upfront + card-on-file to lower friction.
miguel: onboarding can run with 50% upfront; will scope condensed enablement if needed.
olivia: i'll send buyer options: A) 6mo -20% with 50% upfront + delegated-signer addendum, hold SE week; B) convert-now annual at standard price with full upfront and guaranteed SE.
james: attaching updated quote + SOW, will add conversion billing paragraph.
procurement-team: PO draft sent to olivia@veridian.com, includes delegated signer field and KMS billing ref.
olivia: buyer says "Option A preferred, can you expedite delegated signer form? CFO signs Tue."
anya: prepping delegation package and addendum for internal review.
legal-bot: Addendum snippet: "Delegation of Signature Authority: Org X authorizes Person Y to sign Amendment A on its behalf. Effective dates and sample signature block included."
olivia: cc procurement when sending. checklist: 1) hold SE Apr10-14 2) delegated-signer addendum executed Tue 3) PO + 50% payment processed 4) Docusign fallback if wet-sign required.
james: pinging @finance for approval on 50% concession.
procurement-team: will route PO to billing once addendum is signed.
miguel: tentatively reserving SE resources for Apr10-14; will trim scope if timeline slips.
olivia: updating buyer now. will post final once signed. thanks all :thumbsup:
